detail: 5 graph calls; 22 txns in episode window, 2 memory cases, 4 rare devices

rationale: The flagged transaction is a $30.91 in-person, product-W purchase in region 494 — a region the card has already used 21 times (including 2016-12-12, six days earlier) — and the amount is below the card's 180-day mean of $82.40 (amount_z -0.39). Channel and product match 93.3% of the card's 910-transaction baseline, and the surrounding window shows the cardholder's normal high-frequency, multi-region in-person behaviour continuing uninterrupted (13 home-region transactions within 48h), with no card-testing run, no just-under-threshold run, no new region and no new device on the flagged authorization. The only adverse signal is the 0.55 model score itself, which per policy is a reason to look, not a verdict. Memory on this customer is mixed but informative: CC-0003 on the same card was a 0.91-scored alert cleared after the cardholder confirmed travel, while CC-2370 was a genuine card-not-present fraud consisting of online purchases — a channel that is essentially absent from this episode (1 of 22 transactions, $5.92). One minor residual: that single online $5.92 authorization (3545223) used 'unknown | Android | chrome 66.0 | 1280x720', a rare device profile seen on 12 cards all-time and 8 in this window, some with confirmed fraud histories; it does not implicate the flagged in-person charge but warrants passive monitoring rather than action.
